What the <c:ffff00>{{target}}<c> does in reaction to an <c:ffff00>attack<c>.
Before taking it, the <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> that responds is chosen: if
it can <c:ffff00>defend<c>, it defends; if it can <c:ffff00>evade<c>, it tries to
evade; if not, it <c:ffff00>takes it<c> as is. In <c:ffff00>{{medachange_form}}<c>,
defense or evasion is chosen instead of a {{part}}, that
is, the act itself.
If a {{medabot}} is in <c:ffff00>{{guard}} Stance<c>, an <c:ffff00>{{interrupt_guard}}<c>
takes place. If the {{opponent}}'s attack is an <c:ffff00>Aimshot<c>,
no {{response}} is possible.
